rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for none of a countable group, especially before a description or verb phrase.

example.english: None of the students in this class knows how to answer this question.
example.traditional: 呢班學生冇一個識答呢條題。
example.jyutping: ni1 baan1 hok6 saang1 mou5 jat1 go3 sik1 daap3 ni1 tiu4 tai4

rows.note: Use this specifically when none of the people are involved, meaning nobody.

example.english: It’s so cold today that none of them wants to go out.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 gam3 dung3 mou5 jan4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
